symptom: Finance reports that customer statements are not being generated. The statement-worker service logs show it cannot get data from ledger-api, but ledger-api itself looks healthy and the ledger web page still works.
root_cause: The NetworkPolicy ledger-api-ingress allows ingress to ledger-api only from pods labelled role=frontend. statement-worker is labelled role=batch, so its traffic is dropped and it times out.
